_about: Fracture data for the fracture engine (tools/fracture_engine.py). One row per AO/OTA 2018 code. Positions: 'level' = where along the bone (ref knee/ankle = joint line, prox_end/dist_end = bone ends, distal_mm = mm towards the foot; or diaphysis + frac 0..1). Angles: tilt_deg 0 = transverse; azimuth_deg 0 anterior, 90 medial, 180 posterior, 270 lateral. Prism outlines are drawn on the joint surface in (u, v): u -1 = lateral edge, +1 = medial edge; v -1 = posterior edge, +1 = anterior edge. Fragment sides: + = proximal side of a plane or spiral, or inside a prism.

displacements._about: Typical starting displacement (Phase 4). Shaft-type values describe the DISTAL part relative to the proximal part: shortening_mm, lateral_mm, posterior_mm, varus_deg (negative = valgus), apex_anterior_deg (negative = apex posterior), external_rotation_deg. Fragment-type values: away_mm (straight away from the fracture site), proximal_mm, use_impaction (use the impaction stored with a depressed fragment). Shortening is reduced automatically until the bone ends no longer overlap.
